What We Do

Drain & sewer specialists

From a single clogged drain to a full sewer replacement, our certified team brings the right equipment — and leaves your property clean.

Sewer Hydro-Jetting

High-pressure jetting that scours stubborn blockages and buildup out of your sewer lines, restoring full flow.

Book jetting →

Drain Cleaning

Thorough, careful drain cleaning that clears backups and helps prevent the next one.

Clear my drain →

Sewer Camera Inspections

Video inspection pinpoints the exact problem inside your line, so repairs are precise — no guessing, no unnecessary digging.

Inspect my sewer →

Sewer Lining

No-dig lining builds a seamless new pipe inside the old one, cutting leaks and breaks without tearing up your property.

Ask about lining →

Cast Iron Descaling & Epoxy Lining

We strip years of scale from cast iron, then spray-line it with epoxy — reinforcing the pipe and extending its life for decades.

Restore my pipes →

Sewer Pipe Bursting

Trenchless replacement: we burst the damaged pipe and pull in a new one, minimizing impact on your yard and driveway.

Replace my sewer →

About Showtime

Reliable plumbing, at your doorstep

Showtime Plumbing LLC is a dedicated local team serving La Puente, El Monte and Rowland Heights. We built our name the old-fashioned way: answer the phone, show up when we promise, price it fairly, and do the job right the first time.

Our certified specialists handle everything from emergency repairs to complex trenchless sewer work for homes and commercial properties — with the state-of-the-art tools each job deserves.

  • Certified, licensed & insured specialists
  • Same-day service when you need it most
  • Honest, budget-friendly pricing
  • Clean work — we pick up after ourselves
